defs.def: seeming natural, reasonable or sensible 行动、事件等
following or able to follow the rules of logic in which ideas or facts are based on other true ideas or facts 符合逻辑的；按照逻辑的

ex.s: Restaurants like Silo in the UK have experimented with zero-waste systems, but wastED took the concept to its logical conclusion.
ex.t: 像英国Silo这样的餐厅已经尝试过零浪费系统，但wastED将这一概念推向了其合乎逻辑的结论。

ex.s: For the machine, this quality is not in-born, nor is it something introduced by humans; it is a logical consequence of the simple fact that the machine cannot achieve its original purpose if it is dead.
ex.t: 对机器而言，这种品质不是天生的，也不是人类赋予的；它是这样一个简单事实的合乎逻辑的结果：如果机器坏了，它就无法实现其原本的目的。

ex.s: However, you can make logical guesses on the basis of what the speakers say.
ex.t: 然而，你可以根据说话者所说的内容做出合乎逻辑的猜测。

ex.s: Does the writer sequence the points in a logical order?
ex.t: 作者是否按照合乎逻辑的顺序排列要点？

ex.s: Good logical connectors will help your audience understand your point of view, whether they agree with you or not!
ex.t: 好的逻辑连接词将帮助你的听众理解你的观点，不管他们是否同意你！

ex.s: Then try to form a logical paragraph by putting some of the sentences together.
ex.t: 然后尝试通过将一些句子组合在一起形成一个合乎逻辑的段落。

ex.s: Then put them in order to make a logical paragraph.
ex.t: 然后按顺序排列它们，形成一个合乎逻辑的段落。
